scope: Integrate the passing fixed-role feedback fitter into the exact B64/L16 compact 124M matched-NS4 source behind an explicit default-off flag.
implementation_constraints: Add no persistent tensor, dense master weight, raw ambient momentum, or codec metadata.

Defer only the B64/L16 fractional-residual feedback fits until all 24 MLP modules have produced raw feedback; keep Muon requests, weight projection, feedback conservation, diagnostics, and optimizer-step order semantically unchanged.

Run base gain, base coordinate, refined coordinate, residual gain, and residual coordinate phases across the frozen module groups, then write the same existing level and packed-code state tensors in place.
Keep the old per-module path available when the explicit flag is false.
Do not change codec capacity, level initialization, iterations, top-k selector rule, FHT seeds, Muon field, LR, batch, or schedule.

independent_replay_gate.deterministic_tensors: The same 24 production shapes and seeds used by the sealed oracle, extended through packing and decoding.

decision_rule.implementation_test_or_replay_fail: Reject/revert integration; do not run MFU or training.
decision_rule.state_or_memory_or_mfu_or_optimizer_fail: Reject integration for the exact endpoint; do not train.
decision_rule.all_gates_pass: Seal the integration and preregister the original 0.5TPP matched-NS4 compact quality endpoint with CE <=5.3763, absolute CE <=5.3810, compression >=2.8x, and fixed-model compute penalty <=1.10. Do not automatically launch training.
